query: Who can IRS units contact for AI-related guidance?
response: IRS units can contact the IRS AI Governance Board for AI-related guidance. They can provide guidance on AI-related policies, procedures, and best practices. Additionally, IRS units may also consult with the IRS Chief Information Officer (CIO) and the IRS Chief Data Officer (CDO) for technical and strategic guidance on AI initiatives. For specific legal or regulatory questions, the IRS Office of Chief Counsel may also be consulted.
